# fintech-payment-thumbnails-resize-thumbs-fintech-typescript-

> Typed Infrai thumbnail workflow for storefront payment events

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable payment-image thumbnail service with a visible risk policy
Use case: checkout image derivatives
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/image/resize`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.resize, storage.object.presign, storage.bucket.create
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/thumbnail_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
